speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the exact location of your sudden abdominal pain and rate its severity on a scale of 1 to 10. Do you have a history of similar episodes, gallstones, or kidney stones?

speaker: Patient
text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Mesenteric Ischemia. The combination of sudden umbilical pain in a post-MI patient, disproportionate to physical findings, and bloody stools is classic for this condition. I will request immediate labs and imaging to confirm. REQUEST TEST: Lactate, CBC, Troponin; REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal CT Angiography.
